info.title: Medios Controller HTTP API
info.description: OpenAPI 3.1.0 specification for the Medios controller HTTP API, derived from `include/medios/v1/**/*.proto` and verified against `src/controller/http.cpp`. The v1 operator (`/api/v1`) and scheduler (`/api/v1/scheduler`) endpoints are typed RPC-style POST routes where the request body `type` field selects the logical call. Payloads use ProtoJSON snake_case field names (`application/json`) or binary protobuf (`application/x-protobuf`).

post.summary: Submit a controller operator API call
post.description: Submits a typed controller operator Call (`medios.v1.controller.Call`). The JSON body `type` field selects the logical call. Request `Content-Type` must be `application/json` or `application/x-protobuf` (the controller does not accept `application/recordio` or `Message-Content-Type`). `Accept` must allow `application/json` (default when omitted or `*/*`) or `application/x-protobuf` (`Message-Accept` is not used on the controller). `SUBSCRIBE` returns a `200 OK` chunked RecordIO stream (`<byte-length>\n<payload>`) of `ControllerEvent` records with `Content-Type: application/json` or `application/x-protobuf` (no `Medios-Stream-Id` header). Non-leader controllers return `307 Temporary Redirect` with a `Location` header pointing to the leading controller.

Submits a typed scheduler Call (`medios.v1.scheduler.Call`). Request `Content-Type` must be `application/json` or `application/x-protobuf` (the controller does not accept `application/recordio` or `Message-Content-Type`). `SUBSCRIBE` must NOT send `Medios-Stream-Id`, checks `Accept` for `application/json` (default) or `application/x-protobuf` (`Message-Accept` is not used), and returns `200 OK` with a `Medios-Stream-Id` response header and a chunked RecordIO stream (`<byte-length>\n<payload>`) of `SchedulerEvent` records. Every non-SUBSCRIBE call MUST include the matching `Medios-Stream-Id` request header and returns `202 Accepted` (except `UPDATE_FRAMEWORK`, which returns `200 OK` or `409 Conflict`). Non-leader controllers return `307 Temporary Redirect` with a `Location` header pointing to the leading controller.

MediosStreamId.name: Medios-Stream-Id
MediosStreamId.description: Stream correlation UUID assigned in the SUBSCRIBE response's `Medios-Stream-Id` header. Required on all non-SUBSCRIBE scheduler calls; MUST be omitted on SUBSCRIBE (otherwise 400 Bad Request).

TemporaryRedirect.description: Current controller is not the elected leader; retry the request against the URL in the `Location` header.

get.description: Reads a UTF-8 text slice from a registered virtual path. Returns `{"offset", "data"}` where `data` is a JSON string (use `/files/download` for raw binary bytes, #582) and `offset` echoes the starting byte offset of the returned chunk (or the file size when `offset=-1`), so log tailers compute the next poll offset as `offset + len(data)` (#241).

FrameworkID.description: Unique identifier assigned to a framework.

OfferID.description: Unique identifier assigned to an offer.

NodeID.description: Unique identifier assigned to a node.

TaskID.description: Framework-assigned identifier unique among active tasks.

ContainerID.description: Unique container identifier; `parent` is set for nested containers.

ResourceProviderID.description: Unique identifier assigned to a resource provider.

OperationID.description: Framework-assigned identifier for an offer operation.

TimeInfo.description: Timestamp in nanoseconds since the Unix epoch.

seconds.description: Signed seconds of the span of time.

nanos.description: Signed fractions of a second at nanosecond resolution.

Labels.description: Collection of free-form key-value metadata labels.

SecretReference.description: Reference to a secret in a secret store backend.

Secret.description: Secret passed by value or reference.

EnvironmentVariable.description: Environment variable passed by value or secret reference.

value.description: Plaintext value when type is VALUE.

Environment.description: Collection of environment variables set before running a command.

Unavailability.description: Planned unavailability interval such as scheduled maintenance.

MachineID.description: Identifies a physical or virtual machine hosting one or more nodes.

DomainInfo.description: Fault domain (region and zone) of a controller or node.

ValueType.description: Discriminator for Value, Attribute, and Resource payloads.

value.description: Scalar floating-point value (rounded to 3 decimal digits for resources).

ResourceAllocationInfo.description: Allocation metadata on offered or allocated resources.

role.description: Role to which this resource is allocated.

ResourceReservationInfo.description: Static or dynamic reservation entry on a resource.

ResourceDiskSource.description: Origin and backing storage metadata of a disk resource.

ResourceDiskInfo.description: Disk and persistent volume metadata for a disk resource.

persistence.description: Persistent volume identifier and owning principal.

ResourceRevocableInfo.description: Presence marks the resource as revocable (best-effort).

ResourceSharedInfo.description: Presence marks the resource as shared across tasks (e.g., persistent volumes or node-declared store/<name> resources per DR-036).

Resource.description: Typed compute, memory, disk, port, GPU, or shared store resource (include/medios/v1/medios.proto).

name.description: Resource name such as cpus, mem, disk, ports, gpus, or store/<name>.

FrameworkCapability.description: Framework capability type (include/medios/v1/medios.proto). GPU_RESOURCES opts in to offers from GPU nodes. SHARED_RESOURCES opts in to shared resources including node-declared store/<name> stores (DR-036). Note: on-behalf-of TaskInfo.principal delegation is governed by the ACT_FOR_PRINCIPAL authorizer ACL action (DR-037), not a FrameworkInfo.Capability.

OfferFilters.description: Per-role minimum allocatable resource filters for the allocator.

quantities.description: Map from scalar resource name to minimum quantity.

user.description: Unix OS user that executors and tasks run as. Must exist on target nodes when --switch_user=true.

failover_timeout.description: Seconds the controller waits for scheduler failover before tearing down the framework.

checkpoint.description: If true, nodes checkpoint framework/executor state for recovery across node restarts.

role.description: Deprecated single role (default '*'). Use `roles` with MULTI_ROLE capability instead.

roles.description: Roles subscribed to by a MULTI_ROLE framework.

hostname.description: Scheduler hostname. Populated from client peer IP when omitted on HTTP SUBSCRIBE.

principal.description: Framework principal. Required by controller validation (#697) unless the HTTP authenticator supplies a principal (which the controller binds onto FrameworkInfo.principal).

offer_filters.description: Map from role name to OfferFilters.

AttributeConstraint.description: Boolean predicate over a node attribute or pseudoattribute.

selector.description: Selects either a pseudoattribute (`pseudoattribute_type`) or a node attribute (`attribute_name`).

predicate.description: Exactly one predicate branch must be set.

OfferConstraints.description: Per-role attribute constraints restricting which node offers are sent to the framework.

role_constraints.description: Map from role name to DNF constraint groups (OR across groups, AND within a group).

Filters.description: Offer refusal filter applied by ACCEPT, DECLINE, ACCEPT_INVERSE_OFFERS, or DECLINE_INVERSE_OFFERS.

refuse_seconds.description: Seconds to refuse unused or declined resources on the offered node(s). Defaults to 5.0.

Request.description: Single member resource shape within a scheduler REQUEST gang admission call (#323). If `node_id` is set, pins this member to that node; otherwise the allocator selects a matching node.

CommandURI.description: Artifact URI fetched into the task sandbox before command launch.

value.description: URI to fetch (http://, https://, or file://).

executable.description: If true, marks the fetched file executable (+x).

extract.description: If true, extracts recognized archives into the sandbox.

cache.description: If true, fetches through the node fetcher cache.

output_file.description: Relative destination filename inside the sandbox.

sha256.description: Expected SHA-256 digest (64 lowercase hex characters) verified before chmod/extract.

CommandInfo.description: Command specification executed by the command executor, container entrypoint, observer, or finish hook.

shell.description: If true, runs `/bin/sh -c <value>`. If false, execs `value` with `arguments`.

value.description: Shell command string (when shell=true) or executable path (when shell=false).

user.description: Optional OS user override; takes precedence over FrameworkInfo.user.

Image.description: OCI/Docker container image specification for the Medios containerizer.

cached.description: If false, pulls from the registry even if cached locally.

MountPropagation.description: Linux mount propagation mode for host path volumes.

name.description: Declared node store name advertised as shared resource store/<name> (DR-036).

exclusive.description: When true on an RW volume, claims all writer units of the store.

VolumeSource.description: Volume source union (include/medios/v1/medios.proto). Note: Controller task validation (DR-036) accepts only `STORE` volumes on tasks and rejects `HOST_PATH` and other source types.

host_path.description: Host filesystem path. Refused on controller-launched tasks (DR-036); only STORE volumes are accepted on controller tasks.

path.description: Relative path inside container or parent sandbox.

container_path.description: Mount destination path inside the container (relative to sandbox or absolute).

host_path.description: Legacy host path field; rejected on controller-launched tasks per DR-036.

NetworkInfo.description: Container network configuration or resolved IP addresses.

unconfined.description: If true, disables Seccomp filtering for the container.

shm_size.description: Size of /dev/shm in MB (only valid when ipc_mode is PRIVATE).

RLimitInfo.description: POSIX resource limits (rlimits) applied to the container.

TTYInfo.description: Pseudo-TTY settings for an interactive container.

ContainerInfo.description: Container specification. Nodes run one containerizer (FAC3-0025): `MEDIOS` (with `medios.image`) for `--containerizers=medios`, or `DOCKER` (with `docker.image`) for `--containerizers=docker_shell`.

CheckInfo.description: Non-killing check configuration for a task.

CheckStatusInfo.description: Reported outcome of a task's CheckInfo.

HealthCheck.description: Health check configuration; consecutive failures cause the executor to kill the task.

KillPolicy.description: Grace period between SIGTERM and SIGKILL when killing a task.

ProgressPolicy.description: Task progress sampling and stall-detection policy (DR-040).

source.description: Where the executor reads progress lines from.

path.description: Sandbox-relative path (no '..' components). Required iff source is FILE.

pattern.description: ECMAScript regular expression (std::regex) with at least one capture group: group 1 is work percent in [0, 100], optional group 2 is the progress message.

action.description: Required iff stall_window is set. KILL terminates the task with TASK_FAILED and REASON_PROGRESS_STALLED (DR-040).

TaskProgress.description: Typed task progress snapshot carried on TaskStatus.progress (DR-038).

step.description: Completed work units in the job's declared unit.

total.description: Total work units in the job's declared unit.

message.description: Short progress note (bounded at 4096 bytes by controller validation).

sequence.description: Monotonically increasing report sequence number within one task attempt.

observed_at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the executor observed this progress.

TaskObserver.description: Sidecar observer command run in the task sandbox beside the task (DR-041).

name.description: Unique observer name within the task ([a-z0-9-]{1,32}).

TaskFinish.description: Post-exit hook command run in the task sandbox after the work command exits, bounded by positive `cap` (and <= `max_completion_time` when set). Supported only on built-in command executor tasks; refused on custom executors, Docker tasks, and task groups (DR-042).

FinishStatus.description: Outcome of TaskInfo.finish reported on the terminal TaskStatus.finish (DR-042).

exit_code.description: Process exit code when state is RAN.

signal.description: Terminating signal number when state is RAN.

reason.description: Explanation when state is DID_NOT_START or LOST.

TaskData.description: Store mount attribution stamped by the controller on TaskStatus.stores (DR-036).

TaskReason.description: Detailed reason code for a TaskStatus transition (TaskStatus.Reason).

TaskResourceLimitation.description: Resources whose limits caused container termination.

CgroupInfo.description: Linux cgroup information resolved for a container.

ContainerStatus.description: Dynamically resolved container runtime metadata reported on TaskStatus.

ExecutorInfo.description: Executor definition for custom or default-executor task groups.

data.description: Arbitrary base64-encoded bytes passed to the executor.

TaskInfo.description: Task specification submitted in Offer.Operation.Launch or TaskGroupInfo (medios.v1.TaskInfo).

resources.description: Non-empty list of resources carved from the accepted offer(s).

observers.description: Up to 8 sidecar observer commands run in the task sandbox (DR-041).

data.description: Arbitrary base64-encoded bytes passed to the executor.

limits.description: Optional CPU/memory hard limits keyed by resource name.

principal.description: Required two-tier task principal attribution as `kind:name` where kind is operator, team, or run (DR-037). Controller refuses launches without it.

TaskGroupInfo.description: Group of tasks delivered atomically to an executor via LAUNCH_GROUP.

TaskStatus.description: Task status update reported by executor, node, or controller (medios.v1.TaskStatus).

timestamp.description: Status update timestamp in seconds since the Unix epoch.

uuid.description: Base64-encoded 16-byte UUID for reliable delivery; must be echoed in ACKNOWLEDGE when present.

principal.description: Task principal stamped by the controller from TaskInfo.principal (DR-037).

framework_principal.description: Framework principal stamped by the controller from FrameworkInfo.principal (DR-037).

stores.description: Store mounts granted to the task (DR-036).

Task.description: Task record exposed by operator APIs (GET_TASKS, GET_STATE, TASK_ADDED).

status_update_uuid.description: Base64-encoded UUID of the latest status update.

framework_principal.description: Bound FrameworkInfo.principal stamped by the controller (DR-037).

OfferOperation.description: Operation performed against accepted offer resources (medios.v1.Offer.Operation).

Offer.description: Available resources on a single node offered to a framework.

InverseOffer.description: Request asking a framework to release resources ahead of planned unavailability.

NodeInfo.description: Node identity, configured resources, attributes, and domain.

ResourceProviderInfo.description: Local or external resource provider metadata.

DrainInfo.description: Current node drain state and configuration.

Flag.description: Daemon command-line flag name and value.

Metric.description: Named numeric metric gauge or counter.

FileInfo.description: Directory entry metadata returned by LIST_FILES.

Role.description: Role weight, subscribed frameworks, and allocated resources.

message.description: Error description when returned as JSON; libprocess endpoints typically return text/plain error messages.

QuotaConfig.description: Role quota guarantees and limits (scalar resources).

ControllerGetNodesPayload.description: Node inventory partitioned into registered `nodes`, failover-pending `recovered_nodes`, and registry-retained `unreachable_nodes` (#541).

SchedulerCallSubscribe.description: Open a persistent RecordIO event stream. Omit `Medios-Stream-Id` header; save the returned `Medios-Stream-Id` for all subsequent calls.

SchedulerCallTeardown.description: Tear down the framework and kill all of its tasks and executors.

SchedulerCallAccept.description: Accept one or more offers and execute operations (LAUNCH, LAUNCH_GROUP, RESERVE, UNRESERVE, CREATE, DESTROY, etc.) sequentially.

SchedulerCallDecline.description: Decline one or more offers and optionally filter those nodes for `filters.refuse_seconds`.

SchedulerCallAcceptInverseOffers.description: Accept inverse offers indicating resources can be safely evacuated for maintenance.

SchedulerCallDeclineInverseOffers.description: Decline inverse offers indicating resources cannot be evacuated without violating SLAs.

SchedulerCallRevive.description: Clear decline/accept filters and unsuppress offers for the listed roles (or all roles if empty/omitted).

SchedulerCallSuppress.description: Suppress offers for the listed roles (or all roles if empty/omitted).

SchedulerCallKill.description: Kill a task, optionally overriding its KillPolicy.

SchedulerCallShutdown.description: Shut down a custom executor on a node.

SchedulerCallAcknowledge.description: Acknowledge receipt of a reliable TaskStatus update so the node stops retransmitting it.

SchedulerCallAcknowledgeOperationStatus.description: Acknowledge receipt of an OperationStatus update.

SchedulerCallReconcile.description: Query current status for specific tasks (explicit reconciliation) or all non-terminal tasks (empty `tasks` array).

SchedulerCallReconcileOperations.description: Query current status of resource operations; controller returns 202 Accepted and streams UPDATE_OPERATION_STATUS events.

SchedulerCallMessage.description: Send an unreliable custom message to an executor.

data.description: Arbitrary base64-encoded payload forwarded to the executor.

SchedulerCallRequest.description: Submit an all-or-none gang resource request to the hierarchical allocator (#323). Each entry in `requests` describes one gang member's per-node resource shape; when all members can be seated simultaneously, a single OFFERS event delivers the full roster. Decline filters are bypassed; role suppression is respected.

SchedulerCallUpdateFramework.description: Atomically update mutable FrameworkInfo fields, suppressed roles, and offer constraints. Returns 200 OK on success or 409 Conflict if the framework disappeared concurrently.

SchedulerCall.description: Typed scheduler call submitted to POST /api/v1/scheduler (medios.v1.scheduler.Call).

SchedulerEventSubscribed.description: First event on the SUBSCRIBE stream carrying the assigned FrameworkID and heartbeat interval.

SchedulerEventOffers.description: One or more node resource offers allocated to the framework.

SchedulerEventInverseOffers.description: Inverse offers requesting resource evacuation ahead of planned maintenance.

SchedulerEventRescind.description: Withdraws a previously sent offer that is no longer valid.

SchedulerEventRescindInverseOffer.description: Withdraws a previously sent inverse offer.

SchedulerEventUpdate.description: Task status update. Must be acknowledged via ACKNOWLEDGE whenever `status.uuid` is present.

SchedulerEventUpdateOperationStatus.description: Operation status update. Must be acknowledged via ACKNOWLEDGE_OPERATION_STATUS whenever `status.uuid` is present.

SchedulerEventMessage.description: Custom binary message forwarded from an executor.

SchedulerEventFailure.description: Notification that a node was removed or an executor terminated.

status.description: POSIX wait(2) termination status when executor_id is set.

SchedulerEventError.description: Unrecoverable scheduler error (for example failover supersession or authorization failure).

SchedulerEvent.description: RecordIO-framed event streamed on POST /api/v1/scheduler SUBSCRIBE (medios.v1.scheduler.Event).
